entities.name: Jaya Sinhavarman II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaya Simhavarman II, was a king of Champa, supposedly reigning from 1041 to 1044. He succeeded his father Shīlí Pílándéjiābámádié, perhaps Vikrantavarman IV. In late 1042 he sent an envoy with tribute to the court of the Song dynasty.
